title: altromon/AI-SDLC

description: Next-gen Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) framework for human-AI agent collaboration. Combines arc42/NAF v4, Spec-Driven Development, Security-by-Design, deterministic quality gates, and OSS license governance.
